canonical_strategy_rule: Ghost/special-token cleanup is a normalization concern, not a ninth stage.

stages.name: Extract
stages.does: Turn raw HTML into clean prose; retain the article body and drop surrounding page chrome.
stages.v4_defect: Naive HTML stripping retained navigation and cookie/legal text as content.

stages.name: Normalize
stages.does: Apply NFC Unicode normalization, decode HTML entities, remove character-level noise, and collapse whitespace before tokenization.
stages.v4_defect: V4 had no clean_text() in six ingestion scripts; 46 garbage vocabulary tokens and literal [USER] tags entered the data.
stages.special_token_note: Special-token/ghost-tag cleanup is part of normalization, not a ninth canonical stage. Preserve ZWNJ U+200C and ZWJ U+200D in Brahmic/Indic text; remove ZWSP, BOM, bidi overrides, replacement characters, controls, and private-use noise.

stages.name: Language ID
stages.does: Detect each document at runtime and validate detected language against its claimed folder/source label.
stages.v4_defect: V4 trusted folder names and had a Telugu te/tel mapping bug that could silently misroute pools.

stages.name: Quality filter
stages.does: Run Gopher/C4-style heuristics, then a trained educational-value classifier, keeping documents above threshold.
stages.v4_defect: An English-heavy OPUS proxy undervalued Indic text, requiring an Always-ON bypass to protect good Indic data.

stages.name: Deduplicate
stages.does: Remove exact and near duplicates globally with shingles, MinHash signatures, and LSH candidate banding.
stages.v4_defect: Sangraha, the Indic crawl, had zero deduplication, wasting compute and increasing memorization risk.

stages.name: PII scrub
stages.does: Redact structured identifiers with regex and use NER/ML for names and other identifiers that patterns miss.
stages.v4_defect: Dolma used regex PII scrubbing, but the Indic pipeline had no dedicated PII pass.

stages.name: Decontaminate
stages.does: Fingerprint held-out evaluation sets, scan every shard for overlap, and remove training text that overlaps test material.
stages.v4_defect: The Golden Proxy was kept out of training so decontamination could be verified rather than assumed.

stages.name: Manifest
stages.does: Emit per-shard provenance and deterministic identifiers: source, license, contributor, script hash, content hash, token count, and language mix.
stages.v4_defect: V4 copied dataset sizes, generated non-deterministic IDs, and used words × 1.3, which was wrong for Indic by 2–10×.

widgets.title: Cleaning Pipeline Map
widgets.role: Overview of all eight ordered stages
widgets.interaction: Click stages or Next/Prev to update stage detail and the surviving-token bar.
widgets.mechanism: Illustrative survival sequence 100 → 92 → 88 → 61 → 44 → 43 → 42 → 42; clean_text() runs before sha256/content hashing.

widgets.title: clean_text() Live · Session 4
widgets.interaction: Edit/select English web, chat, Hindi, Telugu, code, or mixed samples; toggle each operation.
widgets.mechanism: NFC; HTML entity unescape; U+FFFD removal; controls/ZWSP/private-use removal; bidi/BOM removal; whitespace collapse; ghost-token flagging; ZWNJ/ZWJ preservation.
key_outputs: V4 vocabulary breakdown: 18 zero-width, 4 HTML, 20 broken UTF-8, 4 private-use; 6,340 ZWNJ and 598 ZWJ kept

widgets.title: Special Tokens and the Ghost-Tag Trap
widgets.interaction: Switch among Samvaad/Hindi, SmolTalk2/XML-ish, MegaScience/Alpaca, and NCERT/Header; press Unify to real special tokens.
widgets.mechanism: Shows literal markers tokenized as ordinary pretraining subwords versus atomic tokenizer special tokens in SFT; rewriting all four to <|user|>/<|assistant|> removes the collision.
key_outputs: no ghost markers in unified state

widgets.title: Quality Filter Cascade · heuristic chain + classifier gate
widgets.interaction: Toggle English/Telugu and move classifier strictness from 0 to 5.
widgets.mechanism: Live Gopher/C4-style checks: mean word length [3,10], symbol/word <0.10, terminal punctuation ≥0.30, duplicate lines <0.30, top 2-gram <0.20, ≥2 English stopwords, bullet lines <0.90, ellipsis lines <0.30, word count [50,100000]; then illustrative score gate.
key_outputs: script-aware fix: per-language stopword lists and thresholds
illustrative FineWeb-Edu reference: score ≥3, ~8% of FineWeb (1.3T/15T)

widgets.title: MinHash + LSH Simulator
widgets.interaction: Edit documents, choose six pair types, change shingle size k, bands b, rows r, or load FineWeb defaults.
widgets.mechanism: Word-level k-shingle sets → exact Jaccard → n MinHash slots → LSH bands; candidate probability P(s)=1−(1−s^r)^b and threshold ≈(1/b)^(1/r).

widgets.title: Global Dedup at Scale
widgets.interaction: Run local passes, merge globally, reset; drag corpus-doc slider to inspect memory sizing.
widgets.mechanism: Four student shards contain within-shard and cross-shard repeats; hash identical cleaned text, keep first local occurrence, then group locally-kept docs globally.
key_outputs: memory estimate: 128×8-byte signature = 1 KB/doc ×1.6 overhead; default 500M docs ≈763 GiB, ≥768 GB node

widgets.title: Language ID and Validation · Session 4
widgets.interaction: Compare trusting folder labels with runtime detection; run the Telugu lookup demo.
widgets.mechanism: Script-histogram detector handles English, Telugu, Hindi/English code-switching, and Bengali mislabeled as Assamese; compare detected code to claimed code.
key_outputs: te/tel malformed mapping that succeeds only via fallback

widgets.title: PII Scrubber — Regex + NER
widgets.interaction: Toggle regex and NER layers; raise aggressiveness to expose false positives.
widgets.mechanism: Regex masks emails/phones/IPv4; illustrative NER masks known personal names; aggressive NER can mask non-PII place names (मैसूर/Mysuru).
key_outputs: six labeled PII targets in demo; structured regex has near-perfect precision

widgets.title: Contamination and held-out discipline
widgets.interaction: Leak Golden Proxy, disable/enforce firewall, scan 32 shards, and prompt a canary prefix.
widgets.mechanism: Held-out test/validation splits stay behind a sourcing-time wall; scan n-gram overlap, fingerprint shards, remove hits; illustrative honest score 41% vs contaminated 88%.
key_outputs: five overlapping shards when leak is active
V4 Golden Proxy 6.8M tokens/11 shards, benchmark train splits 11.2B/356 shards

widgets.title: Lineage Manifest Builder
widgets.interaction: Edit source/license/contributor/script/text/language fields; rerun identical text to compare hashes.
widgets.mechanism: Web Crypto SHA-256, content-derived shard_id, token count, language distribution, script hash, timestamp; block unknown/unsafe/missing required fields.
key_outputs: required fields: source_url, contributor_id, cleaning script hash, sha256, token_count; license allow-list
V4 non-deterministic row_number IDs and words×1.3 Indic estimate called out

verification.live_widget_fetch: 10/10 HTTP 200; each response contains script and matched cached local content by SHA-256 prefix
verification.source_scope: Only the 10 iframe refs in Session 4 lesson are included. Other HTML files in axiom-fetched/widgets belong to other lecture content and are not embedded by Session 4.

lesson_sections.content: Raw collection is not training data; cleaning turns collected web/Indic/instruction material into trainable text and fixes V4 priority-zero defects.
Ordered path from raw bytes through extraction, normalization, language validation, quality, deduplication, PII, decontamination, and manifest; clean before content hash.
NFC, entity decoding, control/noise removal, whitespace normalization, and Indic-aware preservation of ZWNJ/ZWJ; V4 had 46 garbage vocabulary tokens.
Source-specific literal conversation markers become ordinary pretraining subwords; choose one canonical real-special-token format at cleaning time.
Heuristic cascade plus cheap classifier; English-tuned rules can discard good Indic text, so script-aware thresholds and protected coverage matter.
Near-duplicate detection uses overlapping shingles, MinHash signatures, and LSH banding rather than exact equality or expensive LLM comparison.
Local shard dedup cannot find cross-shard duplicates; a central large-memory, checkpoint-resumable global pass is required.
Folder labels are claims; runtime detection catches mislabeled Bengali-in-Assamese, code-switched text, and silent te/tel mapping errors.
Regex catches emails/phones/IPs; NER catches names but must balance precision and recall, especially for Indic names and place names.
Hold out test/evaluation material, fingerprint and scan shards for overlap, remove contamination, and use canary strings for post-hoc leak detection.
Every shard needs source/license/contributor/scripts/hashes/tokens/language mix and deterministic identifiers; no manifest means no ingest.

lesson_sections.section: 12. Minor topic: the collection tracker and the dedup machine
lesson_sections.content: Track clean-token coverage across pools and provision the owned central dedup machine; local passes remain useful but are not globally complete.
Choose an approximate 10–100M-token dataset (not the demo), apply the cleaning strategies, explain choices, report final statistics, build a widget, and deploy to Netlify.

lesson_sections.section: 14. What this session commits us to
lesson_sections.content: Cleaning is load-bearing engineering; reproducibility/provenance are mandatory; later mixture/curriculum work assumes these stages have run.

implementation_boundaries.boundary: Per-stage yields and the 100→42 survival descent are explicitly illustrative; the widget is a teaching model, not a measured corpus run.

Unicode/regex transforms run live; the displayed code comment says sha1(clean_text(s)), while the pipeline map and manifest widget specify sha256. Use one declared hash algorithm consistently in an implementation; the surrounding provenance contract is SHA-256.
Heuristics are computed live; the classifier score and corpus meter are illustrative and no classifier model is loaded.
Shingles, MinHash signatures and LSH probability are computed live in JavaScript; FineWeb defaults are cited as a design reference.
Hashing and memory math are live; token counts and machine sizing are illustrative syllabus values.
The script-histogram detector and mismatch logic are live; confidence values are illustrative.
Regex masking is live; NER behavior and precision/recall are illustrative, driven by a small labeled list.
Leak/firewall/scan/canary state transitions are live; scores 41/88 and corpus-size values are illustrative.
SHA-256, token count, gating, and deterministic rerun are live in the browser; example script hashes and form data are demonstration values.
